paper_title: Searching for Low-Mass Axions using Resonant Upconversion
notes: UPLOAD room-temperature resonant AC haloscope using photon upconversion (TE011-TM020 mode pair). Excludes axions with masses 1.12-1.20 ueV (271.7-290.3 MHz) above g ~ 3e-6 GeV^-1 at 95% CL after 30 days of power-detection measurement. The limit applies equally to the standard g_agamma coupling and the QEMD monopole coupling g_aBB; I report it as AxionPhoton (g_agamma). Only the abstract's single coupling value is available (no table), so the limit is encoded as a flat two-point line over the stated mass range; actual exclusion curve in Fig. 7 has some frequency dependence (~26% systematic uncertainty band). Assumes standard virialized halo dark matter (vc = 226 km/s) but no explicit numeric local DM density is quoted, so dm_density_assumed is left null.
